scope: Existing-record diagnostic only; no changed predictor, action, hyperparameter, decision threshold, horizon, new simulation, label collection or independent evaluation.
cohort: Exactly the same other-city8h donor, three local2h blocks, six reused development seed-hours per city.
frozen_reproduction: Both scopes per seed: complete roster, five hard-endpoint MAEs, all15 expected request pairs total/unlocked, four source label contrast net/positive/negative totals and same-label oracle gaps.
probability_calibration: Raw per-flight T/S/P CDFs at service1..13 plus detector10 before hard endpoint decoder. Fixed decile bins; mean predicted, observed frequency, bias and Brier by query column.
diagnostic_populations: All observable common/secondary flights, unlocked, S/T and S/P disagreement rows; also query mask w>0 and w<0 within disagreement rows. Endpoint excluded from signed action-query masks.
repeated_unit: Vehicle-link traversal snapshot-query, not distinct independent vehicles. Retain seed/hour. Equal six-seed summaries for rates/losses; bins pooled descriptive counts. No IID significance or calibration fit.
decomposition: For S choice a and baseline choice b, w=mask_a-mask_b. M_arm=base[a]-base[b]+sum(w*F_arm); M_y=base delta+sum(w*Y). Source correction=M_S-M_B=(M_S-M_y)-(M_B-M_y). Split signed terms, full4-feature contexts and source weight.
evidence_identity: For supported context lambda=n_source/(20+n_target+n_source), F_S-F_T=lambda*(source empirical CDF-F_T). Same action-pair M_P-M_T and M_S-M_P split placebo-count and conditional-real-source components; algebraic diagnostics, not independent experiments.
aggregation: Preserve label-positive/zero/negative decision groups, all TLS denominators and per-seed summaries; no successful-city/seed selection.
outputs: Full flight/decision traces and full bins server-only. Pull compact aggregate JSON/logs only, no raw trajectories or models.
interpretation: Descriptive calibration under recorded PP arrivals and nominal13 score. Selection-conditioned diagnostics are not independent validation; cannot identify arrival response under changed actions.
gate: No new pass gate and no change to previous DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY. No native branches automatically launched.
